newsitem.title: USA: China Pacific comments on stock activity.
newsitem.headline: China Pacific comments on stock activity.

text.p: China Pacific Inc Chairman Clement Mak on Tuesday denied a rumor that the company had issued one million shares in an overseas stock offering and said the rumor was probably to blame for the "recent exceptional fluctuation" in the company's stock price.
China Pacific shares were up 7/16 to 4-7/16.
Mak, discussing the stock price changes, cited "an extremely negative negative statement published on a well known computer network service by an individual on October 22."

"In essence, these statements said that the company had issued one million shares pursuant to an overseas stock offering 40 days ago and that these shares were now hitting the market," he said in a statement.
Mak said this was not true. He said the company was seeking legal advice on the matter.
China Pacific plans to report third quarter results showing "continuing positive earnings" on or before November 15, he said.
